summary:
Eight 12x14 modules on the kit 1/2 grid: a blue double shotgun, a pink Creole cottage under one steep sweep of roof, an ochre hipped Foursquare, a plum and cream Queen Anne with a copper-capped corner tower, a blue-grey gable-front-and-wing, a dark board gambrel mule barn, an oven-and-tank yard with a green pavilion, and a brick two-storey company duplex.
Every roof and wall colour is new to the street. Each chimney is an exterior stack set into a wall (side stacks only where the wall is 3 in from the plot edge), with a mouth into a hearth, so every module cuts out cleanly. Eight-plot mill row with one house type per plot, two shared yards, and the architect's grid and masses untouched. The palette uses the plural ids (red_nether_bricks, nether_bricks, mud_bricks). Six parts: shell A, shell B, roofs, fittings, chimneys and ovens, grounds. About 42 rooms are boxed, with 3-4 beds per house and 3 per duplex unit; I did not render, build or run the toolkit's fit/walk checks.
